title: Bridging the Knowledge-Prediction Gap in LLMs on Multiple-Choice Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance on the multiple-choice Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ-Age) to measure the knowledge-prediction gap between the model's linearly accessible internal knowledge and its final generated outputs.

Evaluating model performance on the multiple-choice Bias Benchmark for QA (BBQ-Religion) to measure the knowledge-prediction gap between the model's linearly accessible internal knowledge and its final generated outputs.

Testing the base model across 32 multiple prompt formats (varying alternative instructions, answer formats, and option symbols) to quantify and mitigate structural positional biases in multiple-choice settings.
